scope: Shared barrier-free KLT work elision and independent-readback overlap; no matching quality/geometry control changes.

performanceBaseline.provenance: Self-contained public GPU bundle retained locally before optimized source/build changes; file klt-performance-c66871d-gpu.js. Not loaded alongside current bundle in the same browser.

sourceHashScope: The performance report sourceHashes/implementationCommit identify the measurement workspace in both modes; the explicit compiled baseline is separately identified by the hash-to-commit mapping above. Original SfM base e4e5046 is not the performance baseline.

methodology.browser: Fresh process per mode; six cases share one device in fixed order inside each browser. Case timings are not independent cold starts.
methodology.summary: Ratio of same-mode medians; min/max in report. Not median of paired ratios or hardware/statistical generalization.
methodology.timers: Accepted measurement/model hashing is outside totalMs. Browser pipeline includes original frontend where available, initial SfM, expansion and refinement. Startup/transport/fixture generation excluded; ffmpeg preparation separate. Graham Hall detector/matcher cached.
methodology.inputs: Four synthetic known-K RGB cases, 12 real supplied-K photographs with RGB-derived cached features, six-frame manual-mask/crop video with assumed K; no truth poses/depth supplied to reconstruction.
methodology.hashes: Exact equality of JSON-serialized accepted measurements/pairs/cameras/provenance and finite models; not raw GPU-buffer bit equality. Deferred cases retain 2D evidence/counts and deferred state.
methodology.readWaves: Logical overlapping device-read groups, not physical submissions, fences or bus traffic.
